data.headline: 2.5 Hour Public Sightseeing Cruise of San Diego Bay • All Ages Welcome
data.description:
#Welcome Aboard!

Triton Charters is San Diego’s largest and newest Catamaran Yacht Charter. On August 1st, 2020, Triton completed its extended 38-day journey and docked in the San Diego Bay. We hold Coast Guard certification for a maximum of 100 passengers on board, with Ticketed Charters accommodating up to 80 guests, ensuring ample space for everyone!
data.itinerary: This ticketed cruise will take you through San Diego Bay to splash by all the major monuments including the USS Midway and under the Coronado Bridge! Our captain and crew will guide your adventure throughout San Diego Bay for fresh air, great music, delicious drinks, and gorgeous views.

data.cancellation_notes:
Triton Charters has a 24-hour cancellation and rebooking policy. To receive a full refund or reschedule your reservation, you must contact us **at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled departure.**

Reservations cancelled or requesting to be rescheduled **within 24 hours of departure are not eligible for a refund or rebooking,** unless ticket insurance was purchased. Guests who purchase ticket insurance may cancel or rebook their charter up until the the time of the booking. No-shows are not eligible for a refund, credit, or rebooking.

Please note that cancellation or rebooking requests are only considered confirmed once you have spoken directly with a Triton Charters representative. Leaving a voicemail, email, or other message does not constitute a confirmed cancellation or rebooking request.

*For special or holiday ticketed events, our cancellation policy requires a 72 hour notice. You may receive a full refund if you cancel at least 72 hours before the departure time. No refunds will be issued for cancellations made within 72 hours of the event start time. You have the option to reschedule to a regular ticketed charter but please note we cannot refund the price difference from the special event when rebooking.

Triton will go out rain or shine unless the captain deems conditions unsafe to be on the water. If the captain makes that decision you will be contacted by a team member to go over your options to rebook.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing Triton Charters! We are so excited to have you aboard! Please review the details below including parking and walking directions to get to the boat. 

###Parking Directions:
When you arrive at our address 2700 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego 92106 you will see a large parking lot on the right located in front of the Brigantine restaurant. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes prior to departure. Google Maps: [Triton Charters](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Triton+Charters/@32.7213411,-117.2299103,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deab7fd72e5973:0x221232ad56159d50!8m2!3d32.7213366!4d-117.2277216)

###Walking Directions:
Once parked cross to the other side of the street on Shelter Island Drive and the path to the docks has yellow markers on the corner. The dock path is located between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange. Once on the dock path the boat is located at the second black gate. **Check-in will be directly at the gate.** Please fill out your waivers prior to arrival and have your ID handy! 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/50q08vOQ1WIBuLNxtT8n)


###Cruise Features
- Splash through San Diego Bay and set your eyes on the greatest monuments that San Diego has to offer including the USS Midway and the Coronado Bridge.
- Your Charter includes a Coast Guard certified captain and crew along with a bartender to serve drinks.
- Triton offers a wide variety of drinks on board including draft beer, wine, mixed drinks and specialty cocktails. Prices range from $8.50 to $14.00.
- Get ready for great music, fresh air, delicious drinks, and gorgeous views! 
- You are welcome to bring some snacks on board to enjoy.

###Please note:
- You must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes before your scheduled charter time. Check in will be directly at the boat. Please fill out your waivers and be prepared to present your waiver via QR code, and have your ID handy before you arrive! 
- Our charter will not wait for anyone who is running late to the boat. 
- For the safety and enjoyment of all guests, parents and guardians are responsible for supervising their children at all times while on board. We kindly ask that all guests be mindful of others, as we reserve the right to remove any individuals, including minors, whose behavior is disruptive or unsafe.
- We do not allow any outside beverages on board but you are welcome to bring snacks. 
- For evening charters we recommend wearing a cozy jacket and closed toed shoes to keep warm!
- No animals are allowed on board.
- The Triton is sanitized before, during, and after every charter. Hand sanitizer is available.
- No smoking is allowed on board.
- Triton may change/update/add or remove dates at our discretion.
